title: Make No Mistakes
premise: Astra traces Alex’s login-page prompt, compares its input tokens and reveals the four-word example in OpenAI’s GPT-5 launch post.

scenes.anchor: Typing 'MAKE NO MISTAKES' in caps literally costs double. And it doesn't even work. But 4 other words can.
scenes.description: The mature presenter opens on the three and six input tokens. A fast riser lands on the ×2 stamp. Four words stay blurred. The blossom turns into Astra’s circular portrait.
scenes.label: hook

scenes.anchor: Your message hits Cloudflare, then OpenAI checks who you are and whether you've hit your limit.
scenes.description: Alex’s login-01 arrives at Cloudflare. The daily messages counter appears here with its own 2025 source. Identity and rate checks are separated by twelve frames.
scenes.label: front

scenes.anchor: Let's follow one prompt and see how it's checked, read, answered and saved.
scenes.description: One stationary five-stop map previews the verbs. The last stop holds through the full word saved and the next half-second.
scenes.label: route

scenes.anchor: The model reads chunks called tokens. 'Make no mistakes' is three of them.
scenes.description: The request stays above two rows. Three ordinary tokens and six capitalized tokens split apart on their spoken counts.
scenes.label: token

scenes.anchor: Then, the GPUs. Your prompt is batched with others, and the model predicts your answer one token at a time.
scenes.description: An occupied worker frees a slot. The waiting login-01 ticket enters that exact slot. A partial reply grows by one token.
scenes.label: gpu

scenes.anchor: Then, streaming. Pieces of the answer are sent as they're ready. That's why the answer types itself out.
scenes.description: Astra hands off the first piece. Subsequent chunks travel to Alex, and the same reply grows inside his chat bubble.
scenes.label: stream

scenes.anchor: Finally, the database. ChatGPT's core PostgreSQL database has just one main server taking all the writes.
scenes.description: The saved conversation leads into a dated close-up of OpenAI’s PostgreSQL deployment. The writer, replicas and reused connection remain in place.
scenes.label: database

scenes.anchor: So it's a front door that checks you, a tokenizer that chops you up, GPUs that guess one token at a time, a stream that ships it live, and one very tired database.
scenes.description: Five rows reuse the diagrams from the walk-through. Each row opens on its spoken noun.
scenes.label: recap

scenes.anchor: In a whole year, that database had only one top-level emergency: when image generation launched, over 100 million people signed up in a week, and writes jumped more than ten times.
scenes.description: The writer returns alongside two measured comparisons from the image-generation launch. Astra covers her mouth.
scenes.label: twist

scenes.anchor: So does 'make no mistakes' work? To the model, it's three more tokens. But OpenAI's GPT-5 launch post says 'think hard about this' can route you to a thinking model.
scenes.description: The three original tokens sit next to the four-word GPT-5 launch example. The words appear on Astra’s voice. She looks away and puffs her cheek at the cut.
scenes.label: payoff
